welcome: Welcome to Aladdin Donair Wholesale. Since 2001, we have been a wholesale manufacturer of donair products. Based in the Edmonton area, we serve restaurants, grocery stores and grocery chains throughout Edmonton and Alberta.

Donair is in the name, but we are more than just a donair meat supplier. At Aladdin Donair Wholesale, we offer various halal meat products, including beef donair cones, chicken donair cones, packaged donair meat, chicken shawarma, burgers, chicken, and more.

We pride ourselves on offering the best product and service in Alberta. Our meat comes with a distinctive taste and texture that separates us from our competitors. Please contact us by email or over the phone for all your meat supply needs and let us know how we can help your restaurant or store today.
